criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name a specific vessel (Waesche), system (V-BAT), and a first-ever operational milestone; the kicker 'Hardware in the water, not a slide deck' is a clean position-taking beat with no banned phrases, landing just at the ~210-char LinkedIn cutoff.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: All three main stories carry both an Alaska anchor and a named industry consequence: USCG/fisheries-enforcement procurement, telecom single-point fragility, and a hard NSF dollar-and-deadline forcing function; Tuknik adds a federal-contracting proof point.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Specifics every 1-2 sentences: WMSL 751, 113 days, 18,685 nautical miles, Dutch Harbor, six named communities, May 27, 7-14 day repair, NSF 26-508, $1M/year x 3 years, June 16 / July 16 deadlines, 10 hubs, $37M, 687,000 work hours.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Drone story backed by DVIDS (primary), Janes, Seapower; fiber break by KUCB (primary) and Broadband Breakfast; NSF hub by the primary NSF solicitation page; Tuknik by the Koniag primary release. Moore's April remark correctly hedged per verified_findings softening note.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, position-taking, no influencer drift; 'Three rails, three clocks', 'the desk's read is', and 'the exception or the onramp' are on-brand register with zero banned phrases.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Five tight 2-4 sentence paragraphs, body within 350-475 words, total ~2594 chars under the 3000 cap, scans cleanly on mobile.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closes with a real, debatable two-part question tied to the three-rails tension, no rhetorical softener or follow-us CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Concrete revisit-this triggers: June 16 NSF LOI deadline, Tuknik ANC proof point, Aleutian fiber fragility signal.

hashtag_count_in_range.detail: 5 whitelist hashtags at end only, none inline, within 3-5 range.

punctuation_bans_held.detail: Zero em-dashes, en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in body. Single hyphens only inside proper nouns (V-BAT, AI-Ready, 26-508).

total_char_count_under_linkedin_cap.detail: ~2594 characters including hashtag line, under the 3000 cap.

one_sentence_fix: Tighten the opening two lines to land comfortably under 210 characters so the stake clears the LinkedIn 'see more' cutoff without truncation risk.
